name: Haemophilus, Pertussis, Brucella, Plague and Tularaemia

reference.source: Ananthanarayan and Paniker's Textbook of Microbiology (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Whoop plus vomit plus lymphocytes: pertussis
reference.pathophysiology: Polysaccharide capsule resists phagocytosis until conjugated vaccine opsonises; pertussis toxin locks Gi off flooding cAMP into lymphocytes, and Brucella survives phagolysosomes by inhibiting fusion, relapsing when therapy shortens.
additionalDifferentials: Hib epiglottitis versus croup by drooling and thumbprint
Pertussis versus viral bronchiolitis by whoop and lymphocytosis
Brucellosis versus enteric fever by exposure and agglutination
additionalInvestigations: Chocolate agar satellitism with X and V strips
Nasopharyngeal culture or PCR in catarrhal pertussis
Brucella STA with 2ME and Castaneda culture
